list.name: Changes
list.comment:
feat(core): implement voice chat connection and UI
This major update introduces the core functionality for the voice chat system. It includes the implementation of TCP/UDP connection handling, heartbeat mechanisms, and a comprehensive graphical user interface.
- Implement ClientSession, ClientTcp, and ClientUdp handlers - Add VoiceCaptureThread and VoiceRecorder for audio processing - Develop VoiceChatUI, SettingsDialog, and VoiceMessagePanel - Include necessary JRE runtime configurations and legal documentation - Remove legacy message data and redundant connection logic

task.summary:
feat(core): implement UDP communication and client logic
This change introduces core UDP networking capabilities including: - Added UdpSender and UdpReceiver for audio/data transmission. - Implemented custom exceptions for TCP and UDP communication. - Integrated Log4j2 for improved logging. - Added comprehensive TCP and UDP integration tests. - Updated project configuration in pom.xml.

feat(core): implement heartbeat mechanism and packet refactoring
This change introduces a HeartbeatThread to maintain client connections and refactors the UDP packet handling logic.
- Add HeartbeatThread for periodic client-server health checks - Refactor ClientInfo with Lombok annotations and lastSeen timestamp - Replace VoiceBufferParser with VoiceUdpPacketSerializer logic - Rename UdpReceiverException to DatagramSocketException - Update server UDP thread to handle new packet serialization - Update log4j2 configuration and pom.xml dependencies

feat(core): implement heartbeat and client cleanup
This change introduces a heartbeat mechanism for both client and server to maintain active connections. It includes a new ClientHeartbeatThread and a ServerClientCleanThread to handle stale client removal. Additionally, several core networking classes were renamed for consistency, and corresponding integration tests were added.
- Add ClientHeartbeatThread for periodic UDP pings - Add ServerClientCleanThread to remove inactive clients - Refactor and rename ClientTcp, ClientUdpReceiver, and ClientUdpSender - Update ServerUdpThread to handle heartbeat packets - Add unit tests for client cleanup logic - Update log4j2 configuration for better debugging

feat(core): implement voice message packet handling
- Add VoiceMessage entity for packet management - Introduce VoiceMessagesSerializer and Deserializer - Update ServerRepository with messages concurrent map - Refactor ClientUdpReceiver to support new packet logic

feat(core): implement voice chat UI and messaging system
This commit introduces a comprehensive graphical user interface for the voice chat client, including the main chat window, settings dialog, and voice message panels. Key functional additions include:
- Added VoiceChatUI and SettingsDialog for user interaction. - Implemented ClientSession and ClientSettings to manage connections. - Introduced VoiceRecorder, VoicePlayer, and MessagePersistenceService for handling audio data. - Refactored connection logic by moving heartbeat and protocol handlers to a dedicated connection package. - Updated server-side UDP handling and repository logic to support new client features.
